name: DEMANDO Rechenzentrum Kaiserslautern
notes: Official DEMANDO page confirms a certified data center in Kaiserslautern with two server rooms; Rheinpfalz article reports about 160 cabinets and maximum power consumption of 1.6 MW.

name: WIKON Global DataCenter
notes: Official WIKON page says Global DataCenter has been operational since November 2000, serves central WIKON server-park functions, is fully redundant, and lists the operator address in Kaiserslautern.

name: LUMASERV Koblenz data center infrastructure
notes: LUMASERV official pages identify certified data centers, a Koblenz/Frankfurt footprint, cloud services, DDoS-protected infrastructure, and more than 5,000 servers; public source does not disclose site-level MW.

name: TWL-KOM Datacenter I and Datacenter II Ludwigshafen
notes: Official TWL-KOM pages list Datacenter I and certified TIER IV Datacenter II in Ludwigshafen. A 29 Jan 2025 company update says the Datacenter II expansion entered operation on 1 Dec 2024 and added about 1 MW of UPS-backed power plus 450 kW of cooling capacity for liquid-cooling/HPC demand.

name: Green Rocks / FRA-Mainz data center campus
developer: Green Mountain KMW Data Center GmbH
notes: Green Mountain and KMW joint venture campus in Mainz; official site describes a 54 MW, three-building facility under construction near Frankfurt, fully contracted to a hyperscale client, with Q4 2026 ready-for-service target. ING/Helaba financing announcement confirms three buildings and 54 MW IT capacity.

name: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz new data center
developer: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz / State of Rhineland-Palatinate
notes: NHR South-West/JGU announcement reports roofing ceremony after major structural work, EUR 29 million state-funded project, enterprise and HPC sections, 144 planned server racks, and maximum IT load of 3,600 kW; source expected full operation by mid-2025 but did not itself confirm commissioning.

name: Kommunale Datenzentrale Mainz
notes: Official City of Mainz page identifies KDZ Mainz as the municipal IT service provider and says it operates an ISO 27001/BSI-baseline certified data center for municipal administration systems.

name: Confer IT / Stadtwerke Neuwied data center
developer: Confer IT GmbH / Stadtwerke Neuwied GmbH
notes: Official Confer IT history says Stadtwerke Neuwied IT was developed into a data center in 2008, municipal utilities joined data-center operation in 2010, and Confer IT was founded in 2015 from that cooperation; public source does not disclose MW.
